output.subject: Your auto loan online payment issue
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us about the trouble you had making your auto loan payment online.

You told us that when you tried to pay online, you saw an error message saying "account not eligible" and could not complete the payment. We understand you then made your payment over the phone with our representative during the call. Being unable to pay the way you normally would is frustrating, especially when a payment is due, and we're sorry for the inconvenience this has caused.

We understand that what you would like is simply to be able to make your auto loan payments online again. Our Digital Banking team will review what you experienced, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

If anything else happens when you try to pay online in the meantime, or if there is more you would like us to know, please reply to this message and we will add it to the review.

Thank you again for letting us know.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Source is a representative's call note, not the customer's own words; confirm details with the call record.
Note says the phone payment fee was waived; confirm this was applied before deciding whether to mention it to the customer.
Confirm the phone payment posted correctly to the auto loan.
Check whether the 'account not eligible' error has been resolved and whether the customer can pay online for the next due date.
Decide whether to offer interim payment options if the online issue persists.
